ai-crypto-attacks.title: AI as an Attacker of Cryptography
ai-crypto-attacks.description: Evidence-bounded assessment of AI threats across five cryptographic layers — keys and secrets in software, implementation flaws, side-channel trace learning, KMS/HSM key policy, and mathematical cryptanalysis — separating demonstrated results from reported telemetry and hypothesised risks as of 2026-11-21.

ai-security-pqc.title: AI Security & PQC
ai-security-pqc.description: Quantum threats to AI systems: pipeline data protection, model weight security, synthetic data contamination, agent authentication, agentic commerce, and encryption at scale.

api-security-jwt.title: API Security & JWT
api-security-jwt.description: JWT/JWS/JWE with post-quantum algorithms: ML-DSA signing, ML-KEM key agreement, hybrid tokens, and OAuth 2.0 migration.

acvp-lab-workflow.title: ACVP Lab Workflow: From Vector Set to Evidence
acvp-lab-workflow.description: How algorithm validation testing actually runs: CAVP versus CMVP, capability registration and vector sets, the prompt → response → disposition → validation lifecycle, ACVP test types, deterministic versus randomized algorithms, the limits of a PKCS#11 test adapter, negative testing, and how to state a result at exactly the evidence level it reached.

aerospace-pqc.title: Aerospace PQC
aerospace-pqc.description: PQC challenges unique to aerospace: rad-hardened avionics, satellite link budgets, DO-326A airborne cybersecurity, ITAR/EAR export controls, and multi-decade fleet crypto interoperability.

arch-quantum-impact.title: Architect Quantum Impact
arch-quantum-impact.description: Architecture decisions that outlast the quantum transition: KMS, HSM, PKI, hybrid deployment patterns, and crypto-agile design.

automotive-pqc.title: Automotive PQC
automotive-pqc.description: Post-quantum cryptography for connected and autonomous vehicles: V2X PKI, sensor data integrity, ISO 26262 safety-crypto intersection, HSM lifecycle management, OTA orchestration, digital car keys, in-vehicle payments, and 15-20 year lifecycle crypto-agility.

cbom.title: Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM)
cbom.description: Choose a CBOM format, discover all your cryptography — including the crypto nobody tracks — give each key its identity and provenance, and make the inventory machine-verifiable.

cc-eucc-certification.title: Common Criteria, EUCC & eIDAS Certification
cc-eucc-certification.description: Common Criteria and the CC:2022 transition, EUCC as the EU scheme, eIDAS qualified devices and the Protection Profiles that connect them: what each claim proves and what adding PQC means for a certified product.

cert-quantum-impact.title: Certification Engineer Quantum Impact
cert-quantum-impact.description: How PQC reshapes cryptographic module validation: FIPS 140-2 Historical transition, CMVP/ACVP PQC testing, ESV entropy validation, EUCC/NIAP Policy #33, and PCI PTS HSM v5.0 scope boundaries.

cloud-pqc.title: Cloud-Native & SaaS PQC Migration
cloud-pqc.description: Map customer-controlled vs. provider-managed cryptography across AWS, Azure, GCP, and SaaS: hybrid edge/origin TLS, cloud KMS/BYOK boundaries, cutover failure modes, and vendor evidence scoping.

code-signing.title: Code Signing
code-signing.description: Protect software distribution — from classical code signing to post-quantum ML-DSA package integrity, Sigstore keyless signing, and secure boot firmware verification.

compliance-strategy.title: Compliance & Regulatory Strategy
compliance-strategy.description: Map multi-jurisdiction requirements, build audit checklists, and construct compliance timelines from live framework data.

confidential-computing.title: Confidential Computing & TEEs
confidential-computing.description: Explore TEE architectures (SGX, TDX, CCA, SEV-SNP, Nitro), remote attestation, memory encryption, TEE-HSM integration, and quantum threat analysis.

crypto-agility.title: Crypto Agility
crypto-agility.description: Design crypto-agile architectures: abstraction layers, CBOM scanning, and the 7-phase migration framework.

crypto-dev-apis.title: Cryptographic APIs & Developer Languages
crypto-dev-apis.description: Compare JCA/JCE, OpenSSL EVP, PKCS#11, Windows CNG, and Bouncy Castle across 7 languages. Provider patterns, PQC library selection, support matrix, crypto agility patterns, and migration decision lab.

crypto-mgmt-modernization.title: Cryptographic Management Modernization
crypto-mgmt-modernization.description: Build a modern cryptographic posture management program across certificates, libraries, software, and keys — iterative, with a business case tested against explicit costs, benefits and uncertainty.

crypto-product-certification.title: Cryptographic Product Certification: Fundamentals
crypto-product-certification.description: What a FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria, EUCC or PCI certificate proves, why scope comes before level, and what adding PQC changes in each scheme. Deep dives: FIPS 140-3 Certification; Common Criteria, EUCC & eIDAS Certification; and PCI Certification.

crypto-registry.title: CycloneDX Cryptography Registry
crypto-registry.description: One canonical name per cryptographic mechanism — resolve the same algorithm or curve across HSM, certificate, protocol and library notations, and see exactly where PQC families fit.

custody-governance.title: Custody Governance & Assurance
custody-governance.description: How a digital-asset custody design is evaluated, regulated, insured, and audited: six evaluation questions with Rule G1 authority checks, jurisdiction-scoped regulatory control maps with applicability gates, and what custody insurance, SOC 1/ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISAE 3000 (Revised), and proof-of-reserves reports do and do not prove.

custody-lifecycle-ops.title: Custody Key Lifecycle Operations
custody-lifecycle-ops.description: How digital-asset custody keys are created, guarded, watched, recovered, and retired in daily operation: DKG and share refresh, why chain keys cannot be revoked, recovery and inheritance, key ceremonies, custody monitoring, access control, backup and disaster recovery, and safe decommissioning.

custody-pqc-migration.title: Custody PQC Migration
custody-pqc-migration.description: What a quantum attacker changes for digital-asset custody and how to migrate: HSM/MPC/enclave quantum deltas, PQ threshold MPC research, Shamir & SLIP-39 seed backups, hardware wallet claim splitting, PQ smart accounts, and phased platform- vs chain-controlled migration.

custody-threats-controls.title: Custody Key Threats & Controls
custody-threats-controls.description: Who can make a custody system sign, and which control combinations stop unauthorized signing today: blind vs clear signing, exfiltration paths, adversary models, AI agent spend authority, the Bybit/Drift/Binance case studies, limits of HSM/MPC/enclaves, control combinations, and hybrid MPC+HSM designs.

dnssec-pqc.title: DNSSEC & Post-Quantum Signatures
dnssec-pqc.description: DNSSEC moving to post-quantum signatures: the ML-DSA-44 mechanism behind IANA DNSSEC algorithm 18, Cloudflare’s 1.1.1.1 resolver-side pilot against the dnstest.dev signed test zone, and what’s still missing before production zones can be signed.

data-asset-sensitivity.title: Data & Asset Sensitivity
data-asset-sensitivity.description: Classify organizational data assets, map compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2), apply NIST RMF/ISO 27005/FAIR risk methodologies, and generate a PQC migration priority map.

database-encryption-pqc.title: Database Encryption & PQC
database-encryption-pqc.description: Migrate database encryption to quantum-safe algorithms: TDE re-keying, BYOK/HYOK key ownership, queryable encryption compatibility, and fleet readiness assessment.

dev-quantum-impact.title: Developer Quantum Impact
dev-quantum-impact.description: How quantum breaks your code: library transitions, larger keys/signatures, TLS/JWT/signing impacts, and a hands-on migration readiness plan.

digital-assets.title: Digital Assets
digital-assets.description: Learn cryptographic foundations of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Explore institutional custody architecture with PQC threat analysis.

digital-id.title: Digital ID
digital-id.description: Master EUDI Wallet: Wallet activation, PID issuance, attestations, QES, and verification.

emv-payment-pqc.title: Financial Services & Payments PQC
emv-payment-pqc.description: The whole payments and banking stack: EMV card authentication, tokenization, acquiring and retail checkout, interbank settlement rails, bank key management and key blocks, and the sector regulation that sets the pace — planned as one quantum-safe migration.

email-signing.title: Email & Document Signing
email-signing.description: S/MIME and CMS: signing workflows, KEM-based encryption (RFC 9629), PQC migration for email security — and OpenPGP's PQC profile (RFC 9980).

energy-utilities-pqc.title: Energy, Utilities & Grid PQC
energy-utilities-pqc.description: Plan post-quantum migration across power generation, transmission substations, SCADA control centers, AMI smart-meter meshes, and DER edge gateways under real-time latency, MTU, and 15–25 year field-lifecycle constraints.

entropy-randomness.title: Entropy & Randomness
entropy-randomness.description: Entropy sources, SP 800-90A DRBGs, SP 800-90B entropy-source validation and SP 800-90C RBG constructions — why output tests are not entropy estimates, why a QRNG is judged by the same rules, and what random inputs ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA require.

exec-quantum-impact.title: Executive Quantum Impact
exec-quantum-impact.description: Why quantum matters to leadership: board oversight, regulatory milestones (CNSA 2.0, EO 14412, EU PQC roadmap), and building a board-level PQC action plan.

fips-140-3-certification.title: FIPS 140-3 Certification
fips-140-3-certification.description: FIPS 140-3 and the CMVP in depth: what a certificate proves, the eleven requirement areas and four security levels, the validation queue, why algorithm validation is not the certificate, and what adding PQC means for a validated module.

5g-security.title: 5G Security
5g-security.description: Explore 3GPP security architecture: SUCI Deconcealment, 5G-AKA, & Provisioning.

government-defense-pqc.title: Government & Defense PQC
government-defense-pqc.description: The federal PQC policy layer: the CNSA 2.0 suite and its dated mandates, National Security Systems and CSfC, Federal PKI and the PQC certificate profile, the statute/EO/OMB stack, and how CISA product categories shape procurement.

healthcare-pqc.title: Healthcare PQC
healthcare-pqc.description: Healthcare-specific PQC challenges: biometric data permanence, pharmaceutical IP protection, patient privacy lifecycles, medical device safety, and hospital network migration.

homomorphic-encryption.title: Homomorphic Encryption (FHE)
homomorphic-encryption.description: Learn what computing on encrypted data can and cannot protect, choose among BFV, BGV, CKKS and TFHE, reason about noise, depth and precision, and optionally follow the advanced HSM custody and assurance path.

hsm-pqc.title: HSM & PQC Operations
hsm-pqc.description: Hardware Security Module operations for PQC: PKCS#11 v3.2, vendor comparison, firmware migration, and FIPS 140-3 validation.

hybrid-crypto.title: Hybrid Cryptography
hybrid-crypto.description: Combine classical and PQC algorithms: hybrid KEMs, composite signatures, and side-by-side certificate comparison.

iam-pqc.title: Identity & Access Management with PQC
iam-pqc.description: Migrate enterprise IAM systems to quantum-safe cryptography. Covers JWT/SAML token signing with ML-DSA, OIDC and OAuth 2.0 PQC migration, Active Directory and LDAP vulnerabilities, vendor roadmaps (Okta, Microsoft Entra, PingFederate, ForgeRock), and PQC-aware zero trust identity architecture.

iot-pqc.title: IoT & Embedded Device PQC
iot-pqc.description: PQC for constrained IoT and embedded devices: algorithm fit by device class (verify vs sign), firmware and update signing (LMS, ML-DSA, SUIT/COSE), constrained protocols (DTLS 1.3, EDHOC/OSCORE, Matter, BLE Mesh, LoRaWAN), certificate size and device identity, fleet key management, secure elements, and the IoT security regulations (EU CRA, RED/EN 18031, Cyber Trust Mark, UK PSTI).

kms-pqc.title: KMS & PQC Key Management
kms-pqc.description: PQC key management patterns: envelope encryption with ML-KEM, hybrid key wrapping, multi-provider rotation planning.

mls-group-messaging.title: MLS — Group Messaging
mls-group-messaging.description: Messaging Layer Security (RFC 9420), which uses HPKE and provides efficient asynchronous group key establishment with forward secrecy and, conditionally, post-compromise security (once a committed fresh leaf key replaces the compromised one) for groups from two to thousands. In this module's illustration, an openmls provider holds signature keys as token objects of a PKCS#11 module (a software token in this sample).

media-drm-pqc.title: Media, Entertainment & DRM PQC
media-drm-pqc.description: How content protection and content provenance use public-key cryptography, read from the editions themselves: the AACS key ladder, CI Plus broadcast conditional access, the MovieLabs ECP specification, streaming licenses and transport, and C2PA Content Credentials, set against what NIST IR 8547 says about the primitives they use.

merkle-tree-certs.title: Merkle Tree Certificates
merkle-tree-certs.description: Build Merkle trees interactively, generate inclusion proofs, and compare MTC vs traditional PKI for post-quantum TLS.

migration-program.title: Migration Program Mgmt
migration-program.description: Build migration roadmaps with real country deadlines, plan stakeholder communications, and track KPIs.

pqc-101.title: PQC 101
pqc-101.description: Start here! A beginner-friendly introduction to the quantum threat and post-quantum cryptography.

network-security-pqc.title: Network Security & PQC Migration
network-security-pqc.description: Prepare NGFWs, IDS/IPS, and network security appliances for post-quantum cryptography. Covers TLS inspection impacts, DPI with larger PQC certs, vendor migration roadmaps (Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Juniper), and PQC-aware zero trust network architecture.

os-pqc.title: Operating System & Platform Crypto PQC
os-pqc.description: Migrate OS-level cryptography to quantum-safe algorithms. Covers system TLS policy (OpenSSL, GnuTLS, SChannel), SSH host key migration to ML-DSA, RPM/DEB package signing, and FIPS mode compatibility for PQC-enabled operating systems.

ot-pqc.title: OT & Industrial Control Systems PQC

ops-quantum-impact.title: Ops Quantum Impact
ops-quantum-impact.description: Operational PQC challenges: certificate scaling, fleet upgrades, VPN/SSH key exchange, monitoring recalibration, and migration playbooks.

pki-enrollment-protocols.title: PKI Enrollment Protocols (EST & CMP)

pki-workshop.title: PKI

The workshop runs ML-KEM and ML-DSA in the browser and compares sizes.

pqc-business-case.title: PQC Business Case

pqc-governance.title: PQC Governance & Policy
pqc-governance.description: Create RACI matrices, draft PQC policies, and design KPI dashboards for board reporting.

pqc-hw-acceleration.title: PQC Hardware Acceleration
pqc-hw-acceleration.description: How post-quantum signatures are accelerated — scalar, SIMD, crypto instructions, GPU, FPGA, ASIC and NPU — explained in plain English and backed by PQC Today’s seven-platform CPU measurements, hybrid PKCS#11 v3.3 results, AMD64 instruction-set tests on AI X1 Pro, and focused Arm/KV260 FPGA experiments.

pqc-risk-management.title: PQC Risk Management
pqc-risk-management.description: Compare quantum-risk planning scenarios, record asset assumptions, and rank editable likelihood-by-impact worksheets.

pqc-testing-validation.title: PQC Network Testing & Validation
pqc-testing-validation.description: Design and execute testing strategies for post-quantum cryptography deployments. Covers passive crypto discovery, active endpoint scanning, performance benchmarking, interoperability testing, TVLA side-channel assessment, and building a comprehensive PQC test program.

pci-certification.title: PCI Certification
pci-certification.description: PCI PTS HSM with the payment operating stack (PIN, P2PE, KMO): what a device approval proves, how to read a PTS listing, what PTS HSM v5.0 changed, and what PCI does and does not require for PQC.

platform-eng-pqc.title: Platform Engineering & PQC
platform-eng-pqc.description: Inventory, migrate, and monitor every cryptographic primitive in your software delivery pipeline — CI/CD crypto assets, container image signing, IaC quantum-vulnerable defaults, OPA/Kyverno algorithm enforcement, and crypto posture monitoring.

pqc-grc.title: PQC GRC

research-quantum-impact.title: Researcher Quantum Impact

tls-basics.title: TLS Basics
tls-basics.description: Deep dive into TLS 1.3 handshakes, certificates, and cipher suites.

trust-services-pqc.title: Trust Services & Long-Term Signatures
